test_policy.notes: IPEDS (fall 2024) lists SAT/ACT as 'not required, but considered'. For international freshmen the admissions checklist asks for official ACT or SAT scores with minimums of ACT 18 English / 19 Math or SAT 450 Verbal / 460 Math, and the catalog also accepts ACCUPLACER as an alternative. Domestic regular admission needs no minimum ACT with a 2.35 GPA (catalog). An SAT of about 1100 clears the published minimums.

requirements.notes: Catalog: $20 non-refundable application fee (economic-hardship waivers exist); the international page gives no fee amount. Freshman applicants need a document-by-document evaluation with cumulative GPA from an approved U.S. evaluation agency (AACRAO, ECE and others), proof of English proficiency if applicable, financial statement, health and immunization forms, and a passport copy. No I-20 is issued until fully admitted. Interviews are not required (catalog).

deadlines.label: International preferred application deadline (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: International page: July 1 for fall (all requirements in by then; later files may delay admission to the next semester); November 1 for spring. Printed without a year, so 2027 is assumed. The catalog's general dates are Aug 1 (application) and Aug 8 (credentials) and say international applications and credentials are needed at least two months before the term.

deadlines.label: Academic/leadership scholarship priority date 1
deadlines.notes: Catalog: priority dates Dec 1 and Mar 1 for the following academic year; applicants must apply for admission and send test scores (out-of-state students also a six-semester transcript). Amounts and international eligibility are not stated.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Not required for students whose native language is English or who transfer from a U.S. college. Also accepted as proof: TOEFL paper-based 550, ACT English 18, SAT ERW 500 or ACCUPLACER NG Writing 250. No intensive English or conditional-admission pathway is described on the international admissions page.

english.notes: Tests taken on or after Jan 21, 2026; the catalog states 4.5 without naming the 1-6 scale.

cost.notes: Tuition and fees are computed from the Fall 2026 Natchitoches schedule at 15 credit hours: $5,087.05 per semester in-state (2 semesters = $10,174); nonresidents add the out-of-state fee of $5,394 per semester at 12+ hours (= $20,962 a year); international students also pay a $60 per semester international student fee (catalog) = $120. The cost-of-attendance page shows undergraduate tuition and fees of $10,772 without naming residency. Room and board is the on-campus figure; other = transportation $3,755 + miscellaneous $2,742 (COA page, 2026-27 aid year)

aid.notes: The catalog describes academic/leadership scholarships based on test scores, GPA, rank and activities, but no international-specific scholarship or published award amounts were found, and it is not stated whether international freshmen qualify. The Common Data Set section on aid to nonresidents is not legible in the PDF text.
